preconditions.description: The input must be a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) for n in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the list must be integers.
The list must contain at least one number.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number with the most digits, converted to a string.

postconditions.expression: len(str(stdout)) == max(len(str(n)) for n in numbers)
postconditions.description: The length of the output string must match the length of the longest number in the list.
